# Example Skill

## When to use

Use when a learner supplies study notes to organize.

## Inputs

- The learner's notes and topic.

## Workflow

1. Read the supplied notes and identify the main ideas.
2. Summarize the ideas without adding unsupported facts.
3. Ask the learner to check the summary.

## Output

A short summary and one review question.

## Boundaries

Do not fabricate sources or claim verified model behavior.

See [sample input](examples/input.md).
